# Core foundation fixtures

Synthetic UUIDs, two departments, nine role keys, twelve profiles, six assets and
conserved portions for C1–C3/audit checks. Fixture profiles are not real Auth sessions.
The provisioning script maps them to actual synthetic accounts without public passwords.

foundation-acceptance.json contains planned core cases, not executed acceptance results.
Run python scripts/validate-foundation-fixture.py for identifier/reference/conservation
checks. No AI, uploaded-file, notification, dashboard or maintenance feature is included.
